package.name: arm_gazebo
package.description: Gazebo (Classic) 3D simulation for the 3DOF delta arm. This independent package hosts everything Gazebo: the arm_sim_gazebo node that bridges the arm controller's joint commands (arm/motor_targets) into a simulated delta-arm model with joint feedback (arm/joints, arm/pos), plus the Gazebo world / URDF model / meshes / launch files. Kept fully separate from the core `arm` package (which talks to real hardware).
